name: 孟菲斯
description: 80s Memphis 设计派：白底 + 跳跃多色（粉 #FF2E93 / 青 #00D4D8 / 黄 #FFD800 / 黑）+ 几何错位。H1 粉底黑字歪角 box-shadow 青色、H2 黄底黑字方块、H3 青色 uppercase、blockquote 带 3 色 border、hr 彩色块。不羁跳跃独一份（vs pastel 柔紫圆润 vs brutalism 纯黑）。适合潮流/独立艺术/时尚评论/Z 世代内容。

styles.h1: font-size: 32px; font-weight: 900; color: #0A0A0A; text-align: left; line-height: 1.1; margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 26px; background: #FF2E93; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #00D4D8, 16px 16px 0 #FFD800; display: inline-block;
styles.h2: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 900; color: #0A0A0A; line-height: 1.3; margin-top: 34px; margin-bottom: 18px; background: #FFD800; display: inline-block; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #0A0A0A;
styles.h3: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: #00D4D8; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 14px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 3px solid #00D4D8; padding-bottom: 4px; display: inline-block;
styles.h4: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #FF2E93; line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; font-style: italic;
styles.h5: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #0A0A0A; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.45;
styles.h6: font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #666666; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.p: font-size: 15px; color: #0A0A0A; line-height: 1.75; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.2px;
styles.blockquote: background: #FFFEF0; border-top: 4px solid #FF2E93; border-right: 4px solid #00D4D8; border-bottom: 4px solid #FFD800; border-left: 4px solid #0A0A0A; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: 16px; color: #0A0A0A; line-height: 1.75; font-weight: 600;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 16px; color: #0A0A0A; line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 0; background: transparent; font-weight: 600;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; display: block; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; border: 3px solid #0A0A0A; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #FF2E93; background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 32px; height: 8px; border: none; background: linear-gradient(90deg,#FF2E93 0 33%,#FFD800 33% 66%,#00D4D8 66% 100%);
styles.code: background: #FFE5F2; border-radius: 0; font-size: 92%; color: #0A0A0A; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono',monospace; border: 2px solid #FF2E93; font-weight: 600;
styles.pre: background: #FDFDF5; border: 3px solid #0A0A0A; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #00D4D8; color: #0A0A0A; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.65; white-space: pre-wrap;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; background: #FFD800; color: #0A0A0A; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 3px solid #0A0A0A;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #0A0A0A; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono',monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 14px; border: 3px solid #0A0A0A;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 900; color: #0A0A0A; background: #FFD800; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 12px; border: 2px solid #0A0A0A;
styles.ol li::marker: color: #0A0A0A; background: #FFD800; font-weight: 900; margin-right: 10px; display: inline-block;
styles.li: font-size: 15px; color: #0A0A0A; line-height: 1.75; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
